MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub backup set-rate [options]

Set backup throttle knobs (persisted; applied live to a running daemon)

Options:
  --concurrency <n>  Concurrent download workers (1-32)
  --max-mbps <x>     Aggregate bandwidth cap in Mbps; 0 = unlimited
  -h, --help         display help for command
